news.title: Trump Administration Asks Appeals Court to Intervene in California Mail Ballot Suit
news.summary: The Justice Department sought to jump-start a lawsuit aimed at compelling the state to not count as many as 20,000 mail ballots it claims were sent to noncitizens.
